teaching.title: Introductory Programming Assistance
bullets: Assisted introductory programming lab sessions covering functions and debugging, and answered student questions during office hours.
Graded programming exercises using an instructor-provided rubric as part of assigned teaching assistant activities.

projects.title: Quiz Practice Tool
bullets: Implemented a small command-line quiz practice tool using Python functions and collections for an individual undergraduate course project.
Tested example inputs and documented the program's behaviour, using Git for the course project.
